Property Description

Located in Latimer County, just 3 miles from Red Oak, this remarkable 5,501.92 +/- acre tract offers a rare opportunity to own a vast expanse of rugged mountain land with productive valley ground in southeastern Oklahoma. Nestled in the San Bois Mountains, a part of the larger Ouachita Mountains, the property boasts dramatic topography with over 1,000 feet of elevation change, resulting in breathtaking views and unmatched habitat diversity.

Approximately 400–500 acres of open grassland, hay, and pasture lie in the mountain valley as you enter the property, passing an old homestead site that offers an exceptional location for a future homesite or lodge. ...
